task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, take a trip south. That done, make an attempt to move west. With that done, try to take a trip west. Okay, and then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Then, try to move east. Next, make an effort to go to the east. Once you get through with that, try to go to the east. After that, attempt to go north. And then, make an attempt to go east. Okay, and then, make an attempt to go south. And then, move west. After that, attempt to head north. And then, try to move north. Once you accomplish that, take a trip west. With that done, venture west. With that done, make an attempt to go west. And then, travel south. That done, go east. After that, make an attempt to go to the east. And then, head north. Next, take a trip north. Then, attempt to go north. Then, make an effort to go west. With that accomplished, move south. Then, take a trip east. Then, travel east. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. After that, go east. That done, take a trip south. With that done, make an effort to move east. After that, go north. Okay, and then, make an attempt to go to the west. Then, make an attempt to head west. And then, make an attempt to take a trip south. After that, head south. After that, pick up the coin from the floor of the damp sauna. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
